address: 4614 Tanana Loop Extension Road, Delta Junction, AK

feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef is grass-fed and barley-finished, producing beautifully marbled, tender beef with outstanding taste.

local_areas: Homer and Anchorage to Fairbanks and surrounding communities
pickup_locations: CSA pickup at the Delta Junction farm store, first Saturday of each month
CSA pickup in Palmer and Anchorage every third Friday, location set by email
CSA pickup in North Pole and Fairbanks every second Friday, location set by email

notes: Run by Tangy and Matt Bates; the about page says the operation began as Blue Creek Livestock LLC (Alaska Grown lists Blue Creek Livestock separately at the same Tanana Loop address, so do not list it twice). Beef shares are sold as grass-fed and barley-finished; the same page says 100% grass-fed beef is available on request in limited supply, so category set to both. Homepage also says grass fed and finished pork, lamb and beef, but the about page describes winter feeding of sprouted barley, hay and chopped barley grain. Half hog and lamb pages make no feeding claim. Contact page says the storefront is temporarily closed (hours were Mon to Sat 10 to 6); online orders and CSA continue. Bison shares are also sold but the site does not say the bison are raised on the ranch, so bison left out. CSA may include pastured chicken and rabbit, but chickens are not named among the ranch's animals, so poultry left out. The ranch keeps dairy cows but the site sells no milk. CSA page says first shares started May 2022; current CSA availability not confirmed. Prices include cutting, wrapping and delivery. Phone has an Idaho area code as published. No zip on the site.
